Reference / http/form

http/form#

Form bodies: application/x-www-form-urlencoded and multipart/form-data (RFC 7578).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let fields = await ParsedUrlEncodedForm(origin: request.body().reading(), limits: FormLimits()).parameters();
fields.first("name");

let parts = ParsedMultipartForm(origin: request.body().reading(), boundary: boundary, limits: FormLimits()).parts();
let part = await parts.part();                    // MultipartFormEnded after the last
if part.file() { save(part.filename(), part.body()); }
else { await FormText(part).text(); }

Description#

Form bodies: application/x-www-form-urlencoded and multipart/form-data (RFC 7578).

Parts come one at a time: read or close the current part before asking for the next. Everything is bounded by FormLimits; by default 1000 fields, 100 files, 1 MiB per field, 64 MiB per file and 128 MiB in all. web/form reads forms of a request more simply.

object ParsedUrlEncodedForm#

object ParsedUrlEncodedForm

This field-only format deliberately materializes at most 1 MiB of wire data. Its single lazy Future owns the body and returns immutable ordered parameters.
